declaration.preface:
At Alchem International Pvt. Ltd., we believe that fair compensation is fundamental to employee wellbeing, dignity, productivity, and long-term organizational success.

We recognize that employees should receive compensation that enables them and their families to maintain a decent standard of living and meet their basic needs, including food, housing, healthcare, education, transportation, and other essential living expenses.

Alchem is committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation practices that comply with applicable legal requirements and support the financial wellbeing of employees.

We strive to ensure that wage practices are transparent, responsible, and aligned with internationally recognized labor standards and human rights principles.
declaration.declaration:
Through this Living Wage, Fair Compensation & Employee Wellbeing Policy, Alchem establishes its commitment to fair remuneration, responsible wage management, equal pay, employee benefits, and continuous improvement of compensation practices.

Employees shall receive compensation that is fair, transparent, and aligned with their roles, responsibilities, skills, and performance.

Alchem is committed to progressing toward compensation practices that support a decent standard of living for employees and their families.

Employees performing comparable work shall receive equitable compensation without discrimination.

All wage and benefit practices shall comply with applicable labor laws and regulations.

Compensation processes shall be administered fairly and transparently.

Compensation and benefits programs shall contribute positively to employee financial security and wellbeing.

Alchem shall periodically review compensation practices and seek opportunities to strengthen employee financial wellbeing.
declaration.scope:
This policy applies to:

All employees, workers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and business partners operating at or for BALLABGARH SITE

All activities including manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, administration, product design, research & development, and procurement.

The surrounding communities and ecosystems that may be affected by our operations.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
We recognize that employees should receive compensation that enables them and their families to maintain a decent standard of living and meet their basic needs, including food, housing, healthcare, education, transportation, and other essential living expenses.

Periodically evaluate wage levels against relevant living wage benchmarks and economic conditions.

Review wage structures annually against applicable living wage benchmarks.

Conduct living wage assessments covering 100% of operational locations by FY 2030-31.

Benchmark wages against recognized standards.

Alchem establishes its commitment to fair remuneration, responsible wage management, equal pay, employee benefits, and continuous improvement of compensation practices.

This policy applies to all employees, workers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and business partners operating at or for BALLABGARH SITE.

All wage and benefit practices shall comply with applicable labor laws and regulations.

This Living Wage Policy shall be reviewed annually to ensure its continued effectiveness, relevance, and alignment with applicable legal requirements, labor market conditions, stakeholder expectations, and organizational objectives.

The review process shall evaluate: Progress against living wage and compensation targets; Results of wage benchmarking and living wage assessments; Employee compensation and wellbeing performance indicators; Compensation-related grievances and corrective actions; Changes in labor legislation, regulatory requirements, and industry practices; Cost-of-living trends and economic conditions; Employee feedback and stakeholder expectations; Opportunities for improving compensation, benefits, and employee wellbeing programs.
